text:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: inference-api rollout v3.4.2 -> prod (started 2026-03-14T11:22:01Z). Commit abc123def. Canary -> all :rocket:

incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx / timeout rate on service `inference-api` (severity: P1->P2). p95 latency jumped from ~180ms to ~2.1s, p99 ~4.5s. 5xx rate spiked to 18% in the last 3min. Affected region: us-west-2. Paging @alex_sre on-call.

alex_sre: on it. seeing the alert in pagerduty. any comments from deploy team? @maria_prod

maria_prod: I triggered canary->all at 11:22, no failed healthchecks during canary. Rollout policy was immediate.

alex_sre: ack. first check: are we seeing 504s at the gateway or 500s from backend?

devon_platform: metrics: gateway shows a lot of 504s and upstream timeouts. Backend app logs show timeout-to-worker in logs: `request timed out after 3000ms`.

alex_sre: ok that matches p99. grabbing recent logs and pod status. running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -n prod -o wide`

charlie_engineer: fyi I pushed a change in abc123 that changed sync eviction in kv-cache and bumped a background batch job schedule. Could be related.

alex_sre: good catch. looking at CPU and threadpool metrics. pods with new revision show CPU spiking at 90% and threadpool queue length increased. old revision pods stable.

maria_prod: timeline: canary (10%) @11:15, went all at 11:22. Canary didn't show timeouts due to lower load. Production load amplified it.

alex_sre: evidence points to regression in v3.4.2 (commit abc123). mitigation path: rollback to v3.4.1 to restore latency. any objections?

devon_platform: agree. quick rollback recommended. I'll prepare the rollback command.

alex_sre: do it. also enable circuit-breaker at gateway to reduce cascading failures.

devon_platform: running rollback now:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=registry/redwood/inference-api:v3.4.1
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-api
```

incident-bot: NOTE: maintenance window scheduled automatically for rollback operation. Expected time 2-3min.

lucy_support: notifying customers with in-flight support tickets who reported increased latency. tracking list: CUST-8812, CUST-9003.

alex_sre: monitoring metrics... p95 trending down. 5xx dropping from 18% -> 2.5% over last 4min. p99 also falling. logs show fewer `timeout-to-worker`.

maria_prod: rollback succeeded, rollout status is complete.

devon_platform: enabling gateway circuit-breaker config to stricter timeouts until we validate causality: `proxy.timeout=1500ms`, `upstream.max_retries=1`

charlie_engineer: confirmed the background batch job schedule change is the likely offender. It runs a CPU-heavy compaction every 30s when small caches are present; under full prod load it causes thread pool stalls. I'll revert that change and open a PR with safer backoff.

alex_sre: good. action: charlie to open PR to revert the batch schedule + add canary load test. devon to run a targeted loadtest against v3.4.2 in staging with cache priming. maria to update rollout policy to gradual for next deploy. lucy to create customer incident updates. I'll draft a short blameless incident ticket.

lucy_support: sent customer notifications for the two known affected accounts. Escalation notes: brief outage (increased latency/timeouts) between 11:23-11:30 UTC, service stable after rollback.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rates returned to baseline. Severity lowered to P2. Postmortem required.

alex_sre: wallet check: no remaining 5xx alerts. keeping this thread open for 30 more minutes for monitoring.

maria_prod: adding postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (background batch job + cache eviction change), rollback timeline, customer impact, remediation (revert change, add canary load test, make rollout gradual), post-deploy runbook updates.

charlie_engineer: opened PR #4789 to revert schedule and added metrics guardrails. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4789

devon_platform: ran a smoke loadtest on v3.4.1 and a controlled test on v3.4.2 with cache priming. v3.4.2 fails tail-latency under primed load; v3.4.1 stable. attaching logs to the postmortem doc.

alex_sre: thanks all. final notes: immediate mitigation (rollback + gateway circuit-breaker) worked. next steps: coordinate a safer rollout for the reverted change, extend canary ramp to 25% for 10min under prod-like load, and update the deployment playbook. I'll create the incident ticket and assign owners.

lucy_support: customers acked the update and will reopen if they see anything. closing external comms for now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: monitoring period passed, service stable. Postmortem assigned: alex_sre, charlie_engineer, devon_platform.

alex_sre: filing postmortem now. closing thread but leaving links in incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
